Name: Angel's Japanese Buildings (Complete)
Author: sonreirblah
Description:
[font=Courier New][center][size=3]-IF YOU WANT TO MODIFY THIS MOD IN ANY MEANS, SURE, GO AHEAD BECAUSE I HAVE NO TIME UPDATING/CHANGING IT ANYMORE, SORRY-


Hi there! Thank you for showing support on the previous version.
Now I've completed the farm buildings![/size][/center][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]Enjoy these Japanese-inspired farm buildings for your farm![/size][/center][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][i]What's in here?[/i]

[/b]-I changed the Farm House 2nd upgrade because I didn't fully liked the first one I made. But feel free to use that one still!

-Shed is inspired by a miniature Japanese shop that I googled, I love it very much!

-Slime Hutch is inspired by the Sento bath house exterior.

-The well is inspired by a Japanese garden ornament called Sōzu.

-Earth and Water Obelisks placed next to each other creates a zen garden.

-Junimo Huts are inspired by Japanese stone lanterns.

- I did not include the Golden Clock but if many would ask for it I could make it :)

[i][b]Currently working on:[/b][/i]

-Interior Furniture

-Interior Bathhouse for the Slime Hutch

[i][b]What could be next?[/b][/i]

-Japanese Clothing for NPCs

-Japanese Valley!

-A new Farm Map
